title: test(spec): split build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts into six files so the repo project runs them in parallel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoPahKKD78gi4RU2syTTB675)_

Fixes #25372

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The card's re-scope (option A, triage comment `6358468116`): split `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` into several files so the `repo` vitest project runs them in parallel. Test-only; no `turbo.json`, partition, `ci.yml` or shard-count change.

## What changes

- **One 5135-line file becomes six test files and one shared module.** vitest runs a file's tests one at a time, so this file (841.97 s, 92 tests, the slowest file of PR run 39893808670) was spec's `test:repo` floor on its own. The `repo` project's pool is vitest's default (`cores - 1`, so 3 workers on a 4-vCPU runner; `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS` from `scripts/vitest-worker-cap.mjs` only ever lowers it), so separate files run on separate workers.
- **`build-schemas-check-mode.fixture.ts`** (not a `.test.ts`, so neither project collects it) carries the family header, the sandbox builders, the #9068 git discipline, `run()`, and every constant more than one block reads. The old root `beforeAll`/`afterAll` become `useSharedSandbox(rootScriptsDir)`, which each test file calls once, so every file builds its own shared sandbox (an `fs.mkdtemp`, so two files never share one). Module state stays per file because vitest isolates each test file's module graph.
- **The 15 `describe` blocks move verbatim**, grouped by subject and balanced on a measured local run of the original file (seconds are that run's per-block sums):

  | File | Blocks | Tests | Local share (s) |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `.manifest.test.ts` | #4711, #16431, #5371, #12588 | 18 | 149.2 |
  | `.deleted-baseline.test.ts` | #4650 | 15 | 137.5 |
  | `.anchor.test.ts` | #5235, #5358 | 15 | 125.6 |
  | `.git-topology.test.ts` | #5370, #5847, #6452 (the three own-sandbox blocks) | 17 | 157.9 |
  | `.retired-keys.test.ts` | #4659, #17969 | 13 | 130.9 |
  | `.deletion-proofs.test.ts` | #4725, #5898, #18865 | 14 | 127.1 |

  Block-local constants travel with their block; constants two files read live in the fixture.
- **Each test file names its out-of-package input.** `check:cross-package-test-inputs` reads a test file's own source, not the modules it imports, so five of the six files at first stopped showing that they run against the repo-root `scripts/` and the gate asked to move them to `local`. Each file now resolves `../../../scripts` itself and hands it to `useSharedSandbox()`, which is the path the fixture symlinks into every sandbox. They stay in the `repo` project.
- **`vitest.repo-tests.json`** lists the six files in place of the one.
- **Budget lines.** Each file carries its own `// test-budget:` line. No CI reading of a split file exists yet, so each figure is apportioned: the pre-split file's slowest CI reading (983.3 s, run 38798542648, the reading the old 1230 line rested on) times the file's share of the local run, times 1.25, rounded up to 10 s (190 to 240 s). Each line says so and asks to be re-measured once CI has read the file on its own.
- **Prose references** to the old file name in `packages/spec/scripts/**` (`build-schemas.ts` and eight sibling tests) point at the split file or the fixture they mean.
- No changeset: `scripts/` ships in no package's `files[]` (spec's `files` is `dist`, `json-schema`, `liveness`, `prompts`, `llms.txt`, `README.md`, `src/**/*.zod.ts`, `CHANGELOG.md`).

## Verification (head `78a4221bd`)

- **No case lost.** `vitest list --project repo` on the old file and on the six new files, file prefix stripped, sorted: 92 and 92 names, `diff` empty. `vitest list --project local` matches none of the files.
- **Timing, before and after (local, same 4-core box, same lock, labelled local):** the original file alone took 839.06 s (92/92 passed). The six split files run together as the `repo` project: 370.44 s wall, 92/92 passed, slowest file `git-topology` 205.4 s. The before figure from CI is on the card: 841.97 s for the file, spec two-task total 1212.41 s (PR run 39893808670) and 1494.69 s in merge-group run 39894014103. The after figure from CI is this PR's own `Test Core` timing table, read by the seat at review.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `typecheck` (includes `check:scripts-typecheck`): exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 711/711 files, 21634 passed, 1 todo.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 66 families on the final head `78a4221bd`; all 66 ran and exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. On the first sweep (head `9f2ed009f`, 63 families) `check:cross-package-test-inputs` answered 1 (fixed above), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` answered 3 (its pinned control commit was missing from the shallow clone; fetched), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` / `check:lean-entry-closure` answered 3 (no built dist); all exit 0 on the final sweep.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's done-when number ("spec's two-task total in a merge-group `Test Core` timing table drops") can only be read after this lands in a merge group; the before figure above is the one to compare against.
- `scripts/git-env.d.mts:9` (repo root, outside this card's file surface) still names the old file in prose, and `scripts/report-test-timings.mjs:935/943` uses the old name as a fixture log line (correct as data). Noted, not changed.
- The cross-package scan does not follow a test file's imports into same-package helper modules. Here each file now names its input itself; other tests whose out-of-package reads live only in an imported helper would be unseen by the same scan. Noted, not filed.

## CI after-numbers (run 39963105499, head `dce4c6406`, `pull_request`, Test Core aggregate job 120460015448)

- **Slowest file in spec:** 841.97 s before (the one file, PR run 39893808670). After, the six files read 457.69 s (`git-topology`), 420.84 s (`deleted-baseline`), 386.75 s (`deletion-proofs`), 147.50 s (`retired-keys`), 140.73 s (`manifest`) and 104.13 s (`anchor`). The slowest is now 457.69 s.
- **Spec's two-task total** (the card's done-when quantity): 1113.11 s in this PR run, against 1212.41 s in PR run 39893808670 and 1494.69 s in merge-group run 39894014103. The merge-group comparison can be read only after this lands.
- **Load cost:** on a shared runner, the files run side by side and each takes longer than its serial share. The six together are 1657.6 s of file time, against 842 s for the one file. The wall drops because they overlap.
- **Shard tests steps in this run:** 10.6 to 20.4 min (slowest shard 4/6). That is a reading of this run, not a comparison of like with like.
- **Budget lines** were re-set from this reading in `ab63b4e7e`: each is the CI reading × 1.25, rounded up (580, 530, 490, 190, 180 and 140 s). They replace the first apportioned estimates (190 to 240 s), which assumed each file keeps its serial share and came in under the three heaviest readings.
